name: Arena-Hard
intro: Arena-Hard 是从 Chatbot Arena 实时数据构建高质量基准的数据流水线页；它与 Arena-Hard-Auto-v0.1 指向同一份 500 题发布，并非另一份独立数据集。论文 v2 从 20 万条查询去重并保留单轮英文提示，经 text-embedding-3-small、UMAP 与 HDBSCAN 形成 4,000 个不同主题，再由 LLM 总结并命名；随后用 GPT-4-Turbo 进行七项质量评分，保留提示得分至少 6 且簇均分至少 5 的 500 多个簇。流程随机选择 250 簇、每簇 2 题，并在发布前清除 PII 与冒犯性内容。评测再经位置互换的成对裁判、严格标签解析、加权 battle 与 Bradley-Terry/Elo 尺度拟合得到相对基线胜率。
build_method: 20万条众包查询去重并保留单轮英文提示, text-embedding-3-small + UMAP + HDBSCAN形成4,000个不同主题并由LLM总结命名, GPT-4-Turbo按七项标准逐条评分0–7, 保留提示得分至少6且簇均分至少5得到500多个簇, 随机选择250簇并每簇抽2题, 采样后清除PII与冒犯性内容
task_type: 开放式对话, 指令跟随
eval_feature: 单轮真实用户困难提示, 位置互换成对LLM裁判, 严格标签解析, Bradley-Terry汇总
build_method_en: Deduplicate 200,000 crowdsourced queries and keep single-turn English prompts; use text-embedding-3-small, UMAP, and HDBSCAN to form 4,000 distinct topics summarized and named by an LLM; use GPT-4-Turbo to score seven criteria from 0–7; keep prompts scoring at least 6 and clusters averaging at least 5 to obtain more than 500 clusters; randomly select 250 clusters and two prompts each; then remove PII and offensive content after sampling
eval_feature_en: Single-turn Real-User Hard Prompts, Swapped Pairwise LLM Judging, Strict Verdict Parsing, Bradley-Terry Aggregation
intro_en: Arena-Hard is the data-pipeline page for building a high-quality benchmark from live Chatbot Arena data. It points to the same 500-prompt Arena-Hard-Auto-v0.1 release, not a separate dataset. Paper v2 deduplicates 200,000 queries and keeps single-turn English prompts; text-embedding-3-small, UMAP, and HDBSCAN form 4,000 distinct topics that are summarized and named by an LLM. GPT-4-Turbo seven-criteria scores then retain prompts scoring at least 6 and clusters averaging at least 5, leaving more than 500 clusters. It randomly selects 250 clusters and two prompts each, then removes PII and offensive content before release. Evaluation uses swapped pairwise games, strict verdict parsing, weighted battles, and a Bradley-Terry fit parameterized on an Elo scale to report win rate against the baseline.
metric_en: Win Rate vs gpt-4-0314, 95% Confidence Interval

drawio_review_note: Reviewed with arXiv manuscript 2406.11939v2 as the paper v2 main construction chain: deduplicate 200,000 Chatbot Arena prompts, keep single-turn English prompts, run text-embedding-3-small + UMAP + HDBSCAN to form 4,000 distinct topics summarized and named by an LLM, use GPT-4-Turbo to score seven criteria from 0–7, keep each prompt score at least 6 and each cluster mean at least 5 to retain more than 500 clusters, randomly select 250 clusters and two prompts each, and only then remove PII and offensive content before the 500-prompt release. The pinned BenchBuilder topic_clustering.py names topics with gpt-4o-mini; this is fixed-implementation version evidence, not a replacement for the paper-v2 model-agnostic LLM wording. The official April blog https://www.lmsys.org/blog/2024-04-19-arena-hard/ instead describes 250 clusters with cluster mean at least 6; that threshold is retained only as version evidence, not the paper-v2 main chain. GPT-3.5 appears only in v1/repository history and is likewise version evidence, not part of the paper-v2 quality-annotation node. Arena-Hard names the pipeline page for the same Arena-Hard-Auto-v0.1 release and no separate 500-prompt dataset was found. The exact source snapshot, filter implementation, sampling seed, and safety-cleanup procedure are not public. The pinned evaluator is lmarena/arena-hard-auto@b4cbc3e31bc9b2557f277f7d40177a7b5a011fc2 and uses gpt-4-0314 as baseline, gpt-4-1106-preview at temperature 0 and max_tokens 4096, two swapped games, and five exact verdict labels. Its set-based parser handles four cases: no label requests a continuation and may retry for at most 2 total attempts; a single label is accepted; a repeated same label is also accepted; conflicting distinct labels are invalid with no retry and are dropped downstream. Strong/slight/tie battle weights feed an unregularized Bradley-Terry fit in Elo-scale parameterization anchored at 1,000, conversion to baseline win rate, and 100-round 95% bootstrap intervals. Later benchmark v2.0 prompts, judges, and scoring are not mixed into this v0.1 page; the arXiv v2 suffix names the manuscript revision.
